title: Does LinkedIn's "Open to Work" REALLY Make a Difference? 🔍
description:
Does the “Open to Work” banner on LinkedIn REALLY make a difference? In a number of ways it actually does. One, it can signal to your network you are looking (you never know what opportunity might come from that) but two, it is actually filter that LinkedIn Recruiters can use to find talent. #linkedin #linkedintips #opentowork
